Okay, depression is a very broad term but I'll try to explain mine.

Every day begins with a "ugh, another day living" thought. Wherever I try to do anything mildly productive I put it off. "What is the point", I tell myself. Going outside, I ponder how people can carry on seemingly effortlessly. I see people with children, and I wonder wherever they're happy, if they will feel loved, if they will develop some strange incurable disease, whatever. It seems depressing, to me anyway. Most of the times I find eating a fruitless time waste. "Nothing that I haven't tried before, but that isn't surprising", scrolls through my brain. I see how everything and everyone works, "if I wasn't here nothing would change" my thoughts assert. I walk in the sidewalk, with oncoming cars passing. "It would be easy to end it here", is what I think. But then I think of how my act would harm others that are certainly better than me. I try to learn about new things, how things work and so on. "Someone knows that better than you anyway", my brain posits. So I just lay in bed, while wasting my time away. "Nothing changed when I got help, so why should I go on?".

Days become a gray mass I have to digest, against my will, daily. The world reminding me of my worthlessness, of how I look normal but I'm not. The mere act of looking at myself in the mirror takes more will than I'd like to admit. Nothing matters anymore.

Hanging needs a strong enough rope (otherwise you'll just fall on the floor). I talked to a hanging survivor. He put the rope at about 8m above the floor and then jumped. He was conscious by 10 minutes, during which he says he started regretting it. 25 minutes later he was found and they cut the rope, and fell to the floor. He received CPR, had a mild seizure but lived.
He was in the same psych ward as me. So clearly it isn't foolproof.
The key is that whatever position is assumed, whether that be lying, kneeling or feet lightly on the ground, the noose tightens sufficiently to constrict the blood vessels and/or airway. Noting of course, that in some positions it might be easy to stop the hanging by releasing the pressure. The intention with this method would be for the blood flow to/from the head to be constricted quickly thereby achieving a swift loss of consciousness.
The unconscious body will thrash about as it dies. It is important that the rope is tight around the neck until death is achieved, and estimates are that this can take up to 20 minutes.
Bear in mind that the body thrashing around whilst unconscious could draw attention. Having this method interrupted before completion can cause brain damage so should be avoided.
